verdicts.reason: Both use the same layout with the same flaws. The light-blue highlight bar has come loose from 'HOUSE' and floats as a meaningless stripe. The subtitle sits jammed against the headline and breaks badly, leaving 'towels,' alone on its own line. The hero photo of the pillows has shrunk to a small strip, and a large empty band is left at the bottom. B is shifted further up, so its bottom gap is even bigger and it looks more top-heavy; A is spread slightly more evenly down the canvas.
